question:
After interchanging the given two signs what will be the values of expression (I) and (II) respectively?

× and -

I. 24 ÷ 8 × 2 + 7 - 6

II. 8 × 6 - 9 ÷ 3 + 10
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ff1ff4b88aae7a27d49a7cf8f26f239baa99376445cb020aac8fae8fa7596ed.png] 

Equation I: 24 ÷ 8 × 2 + 7 - 6

After interchanging × and -, we get the equations:

→ **__24 ÷ 8__** - 2 + 7 × 6

→ 3 - 2 + **__7 × 6__** =?

→ __**3**__ - 2 **__+ __****__4__2** =?

→ __**45 - 2**__ = **43.**

Equation II. 8 × 6 - 9 ÷ 3 + 10

After interchanging × and -, we get the equations:

→ 8 - 6 × **__9 __****__÷ 3__** + 10

→ 8 - **__6 × 3__ **+ 10 =?

→ __**8**__ - 18 **__+ 10__** =?

→ __**18 - 18**__ = **0**.

Hence, the correct answer is **" 43 and 0 "**.
